task_name: `screen.ts`: el vocabulario de pantallas y la decisión
summary: New pure module web/src/screen.ts decides which of the five Screen members a SummaryLoad maps to: ScreenChoice.of dispatches over the closed status vocabulary with a switch and no default branch, resolves the repo name once from the selected Clone (falling back to its id), and derives the empty-window call to action from summary.window against DEFAULT_WINDOW. Built test-first with the control-tower-loop:test-driven-development skill (loaded without error), one red-green cycle per case, and each assertion afterwards seen to fail for the reason its name gives by hand-breaking the branch order, the repo-name fallback and the clone pass-through. All four Verification commands pass with exit 0 (7 test names in screen.test.ts, no React or api/client import, npm test -w web with 63 tests green, build and lint clean). Two things the next task should know: the Tests list has no case of its own for 'the repo name falls back to the repoId when no clone matches', so that rule is pinned as a second assertion inside the analysing test rather than as an eighth test, because the verification command demands exactly seven; and the blocks member carries activity beside the summary it is derived from, which is a field that has to agree with summary.kpis.commits, accepted here because it is the closed decision that keeps the empty-window rule in this module instead of letting App.tsx re-derive it in TSX.

`screen.ts`: la frescura de la foto y la línea de historial
summary: web/src/screen.ts now answers with a Dashboard (screen + HeaderHistory + SnapshotNotice) instead of a bare Screen: the snapshot notice is read only from the selected clone of GET /repos (fetchedAt null or no selected clone gives never-fetched, and the payload's stale flag is copied, never recomputed from the date), and the header history is derived by an exhaustive dispatch over the five Screen members with no default branch, so the no-commits screen answers none and a loaded window answers last-commit with meta.lastCommitAt. Two things the next task needs to know: ScreenChoice.of changed its public return type, and no caller had to be touched because App.tsx does not import screen.ts yet, so whoever wires the shell must read the Dashboard's screen member; and the branch where a loaded blocks screen has meta.lastCommitAt null answers unknown but has no test of its own, because the plan declared exactly four new test names and the task's own verification pins the file at eleven tests, so a fifth would have failed the check.
